answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Every claim climbs the sparrow of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the comet re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a checklist tone, short verdict at the end register, it stays short. The pearl of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
